scripts.desktop:install: npm --prefix sdks/typescript ci && npm --prefix sdks/typescript run build && npm --prefix apps/desktop ci
scripts.desktop:dev: cargo build -p haarness-cli && npm --prefix sdks/typescript run build && npm --prefix apps/desktop run dev
scripts.desktop:build: cargo build --release -p haarness-cli && npm --prefix sdks/typescript run build && npm --prefix apps/desktop run build
scripts.desktop:test: npm --prefix apps/desktop test && npm --prefix apps/desktop run test:e2e
scripts.extension:test: npm --prefix apps/browser-extension test && npm --prefix apps/browser-extension run test:e2e
